paragraphs.source_en: "I know him slightly; we have some friends in common" (Swann dared not add that one of these friends was the Prince of Wales). paragraphs.source_en: But so great and glorious a figure was the President of the French Republic in the eyes of Dr. Cottard that neither the modesty of Swann nor the spite of Mme. Verdurin could ever wholly efface that first impression, and he never sat down to dinner with the Verdurins without asking anxiously, "D'you think we shall see M. Swann here this evening?
